title: Machine-readable failures for every client command and a consistent selected project
request: Every client command failure, including an argument-parse error, must end in a non-zero exit and, in machine-readable mode, exactly one structured report with a false success flag, the command the user asked for and the project in effect; human-readable mode prints the message on the error channel only. The selected project must be passed to the engine by every command that acts on a project and must not be passed by a command that does not, and the reported project must equal the project actually sent.
